text: まいにち　こんな　だと　いいわい

structure.jp: まいにち　こんな　だと
structure.en: if every day is like this

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: と followed by いい means 'it would be good if', and is how you say a wish. こんな　だと　いい = 'I wish it were like this'.

patterns.name: 〜わい
patterns.explanation: わい at the end is an old-man way of adding feeling to what you say. いいわい = 'it'd be good, I tell you'.
